pages.title: Sewage
pages.text: Sewage is generated in some industrial production processes, but it is also a raw material for other production processes and can be treated using Water Treatment Unit;$(br2)Sewage can be transported through pipelines, which can be used to connect the sewage source and Water Treatment Unit;$(br2)Living entities will be damaged in sewage, do not stay in sewage!

pages.title: Precipitation Acid
pages.text: Important production raw materials with properties similar to Sewage;$(br2)Precipitation acid cannot be directly synthesized at present, and Precipitation Acid Lakes can be found on the surface of the overworld (1/50 per chunk), which can be obtained in bucket;

pages.title: Liquid Xiranite
